correctness.rationale: Every minimum FVS intersects all n square faces; the unique minimum odd-cycle cover has one adjacent pair. Edge counting forces independence and a constructive retained-tree argument proves sufficiency. The coordinate mapping lists all exchanges; monodromy T^n=T yields connectivity, parity yields bipartition and base-projection enumeration gives all four-cycles. Direct exhaustive prism enumeration n=5,7,9,11,13 and independent bit-transfer graph checks n=5,7,...,17 corroborate counts and adjacency. The infinite theorem follows from the written proof, not these tests.
